title: Bomb
features: Just a bomb, 0 errors, tested only on Delta, and made with gemini 3
script:
--[[
    NOT A CANDY BOMB 🚫🍬
    DEVELOPER: GLEB (ГЛЕБ) 🥓🔴
--]]

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local IDS = {
    ToolTexture = "rbxassetid://12222334",
    ModelId = "rbxassetid://12221733",
    ModelTexture = "rbxassetid://12222348",
    FuseSound = "rbxassetid://12221976", 
    ExplosionSound = "rbxassetid://12222084" 
}

local BombTool = Instance.new("Tool")
BombTool.Name = "Real Bomb (No Candy)"
BombTool.TextureId = IDS.ToolTexture
BombTool.Parent = backpack

local Handle = Instance.new("Part")
Handle.Name = "Handle"
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) -- Нормальный размер!
Handle.Parent = BombTool

local Mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
Mesh.MeshId = IDS.ModelId
Mesh.TextureId = IDS.ModelTexture
Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2) -- ТЕПЕРЬ ЭТО БОМБА, ГЛЕБ!
Mesh.Parent = Handle

BombTool.Activated:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    local bomb = Instance.new("Part")
    bomb.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
    bomb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    bomb.Position = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    bomb.Parent = game.Workspace
    
    local m = Mesh:Clone()
    m.Parent = bomb
    
    bomb.Velocity = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 30 + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)
    
    local fuse = Instance.new("Sound", bomb)
    fuse.SoundId = IDS.FuseSound
    fuse:Play()
    
    task.wait(3.5)
    
    if bomb and bomb.Parent then
        -- ЗВУК ТОЛЬКО ТУТ!
        local s = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
        s.SoundId = IDS.ExplosionSound
        s:Play()
        
        local ex = Instance.new("Explosion")
        ex.Position = bomb.Position
        ex.BlastRadius = 15
        ex.Parent = game.Workspace
        
        bomb:Destroy()
        task.wait(2)
        s:Destroy()
    end
end)
